notes: Acquisition pipeline: a new Pipeline console view runs the six-stage flow source -> qualify -> draft -> approve -> send -> track. Leads come only from your own signals (hand-added, pasted lists, or your own public forum threads - no bought or scraped lists); qualification is a contactability score shown with its arithmetic; each qualified lead gets one editable draft. Nothing is sent without your click: every send re-checks the kill switch, the approval, a valid non-suppressed address, the CAN-SPAM postal address, the email route and the Beijing-day cap, and every message carries Reply-To and List-Unsubscribe headers. Inbound mail from a known lead is triaged (opt-out honored permanently) and never auto-answered. Also ships the customer-acquisition operator skill and the geo-rank skill for AI-answer visibility assessment.
